CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Winter-2020 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Winter-2020 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 669 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 2 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: June 2020 to August 2020). These surveys captured 53 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 9 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 531 cards across 52 sites, with 8.3% showing evidence of mouse activity (44 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 228 transects across 54 sites (survey period: June 2020 to July 2020), detecting active burrows in 1.8% of transects (total: 7 active burrows).
